assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All site, research, and key-area boundaries are provisional rough polygons drawn by maintainers from official text; recomputed areas deviate from officially announced values.
assumptions.impact: Land-use zoning, all area metrics, figures, drawings, and the offline visualization must be recalculated when official vectors arrive; officially announced areas remain authoritative for any precise-area statement.

assumptions.statement: Total floor area and FAR convert footprints with assumed storey counts per building type (3-16 floors).
assumptions.impact: total_floor_area_sqm and floor_area_ratio are conceptual supply checks, not approved development quanta.

assumptions.statement: Building condition, ownership, tenancy, utility, and heritage-zone vector data are not part of the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish statements stay district-level directions; no parcel-level demolition conclusion is made.
